$comment: Codex CLI hooks template. Install to $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json. Commands reference the portable scripts in adapters/shared/hooks, which an installer places in $CODEX_HOME/hooks/. Only handlers with type 'command' execute; 'prompt' and 'agent' parse but are skipped. Non-managed command hooks are hash-trusted and must be approved once via the in-TUI /hooks command. Hook layers are additive, so do not also declare these as [[hooks.*]] in config.toml. Only the events backed by a shipped script are wired here; more will be added as the shared hook set grows.
